prior_art.title: The Potential of the Copernicus Product 'Imperviousness Classified Change' to Assess Soil Sealing in Agricultural Areas in Poland and Norway
prior_art.why: Same problem framing on the EU's own operational product: finds high commission error from 'misclassification of bare soil or sand as impervious' on agricultural fields. Diagnoses the exact confound but proposes manual verification, not an automated crop-duration fix, so it does not close.

prior_art.title: Harmonized Pan-European Time Series for Monitoring Soil Sealing
prior_art.why: Same output space: an EEA38+UK annual soil-sealing change-layer product from EO time series, already positioned as the best current EU policy dataset, contradicting the candidate's 'coarse inventory' framing. Explicitly does not handle crop-rotation bare soil, so it does not close alone.

prior_art.title: A novel remote sensing-based approach to determine loss of agricultural soils due to soil sealing - a case study in Germany
prior_art.why: Uses IMCC change layers plus CORINE land use to quantify agricultural soil loss from sealing in Germany, but does not explicitly test or filter the bare-soil-crop-rotation confound; inherits IMCC's own documented misclassification risk.

prior_art.title: Area Monitoring - Bare Soil Marker
prior_art.why: Adjacent, live product family: S2-time-series per-parcel bare-soil classification used in EU CAP Area Monitoring. Classifies ploughing/harvest bare soil as farming activity but never tests that bare soil against a sealing hypothesis.

type_b_fields.measurable_axis: Commission-error rate for false 'sealed' flags on ag parcels during normal crop bare-soil windows, vs IMCC's documented commission error from bare-soil/sand misclassification.
type_b_fields.attributable_to: Gating the sealing flag per parcel against CLMS main-crop-duration history (expected bare-soil calendar), instead of IMCC's NDVI-threshold classification with no crop-phenology conditioning.

nearest_neighbours_do_not: None tie the sealing signal to per-parcel CLMS crop-duration/phenology history: IMCC uses plain NDVI thresholds (high commission error from bare soil per Land 2025); the harmonized pan-EU time series explicitly skips crop-rotation handling; and CAP's bare-soil marker classifies ploughing/harvest bare soil as farming activity rather than screening it for sealing.
